name: s2-free-dp700-path
label: EXAMPLE · AI STAND-IN VOICE · NO FACE

lines.say: Microsoft gave away free Fabric certification exams this summer.
And most people missed it because they weren't ready.
lines.show: Most people *missed it*. They weren't ready.

lines.say: The last round, Fabric Data Days, closed in August.
To get a voucher you had to join the Fabric Community, watch sessions and finish Microsoft Learn modules.
So here's how to be ready before the next one drops.
One: pick DP-700, the Fabric Data Engineer exam, or DP-600 if you're a Power BI person.
lines.title: PICK YOUR EXAM
lines.sub: DP-700 Data Engineer · DP-600 if you're a Power BI person
lines.tts: One: pick D P seven hundred, the Fabric Data Engineer exam, or D P six hundred if you're a Power B I person.

lines.say: Two: do the free Microsoft Learn path for it now. It's the same content the vouchers asked for.
lines.title: DO THE FREE PATH

lines.say: Three: take the free practice assessment until you pass it twice.
Then when the vouchers come back, you claim one and book the exam the same week.
lines.show: Vouchers back? Claim one. *Book that week.*

lines.say: Follow so you hear about the next round the day it opens.
